title: roldana oaxacana
intro: Roldana oaxacana, commonly known as Mexican Mountain Mint, is a perennial plant native to Mexico, belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate respiratory issues and skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. Bioactive constituents of Roldana oaxacana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
